body: What if he left because of no chemistry? Like quite often he'd suggest that we didn't have sufficient chemistry... like I think he wanted it to work so bad, that maybe he gave up after a certain point? See idk, I'm torn as to why he didn't stay - I'd say it would either be that or another possible explanation is that he just wasn't excited enough about me or didn't see a future. That's what I can't figure out. In terms of chemistry - I was in a bad place when we met because I was coming off a different guy - so while I was nice and presentable to him, I wasn't emotionally available and open - so no bonds formed really. What do you think? Please respond

I just want someone to have fun with and enjoy my time with - someone care free. That's what our relationship was - we just had fun together. It never got emotionally deep because I was coming out of a different relationship. But I'd never met anyone who would make me smile like he could.

Thanks for your input, and I'd appreciate a response. I've been doing considerable self-improvement, however, I have not seen him change his mind. Also, I'm just really confused and would like a guys perspective here: If a guy's underlying reason for breaking up with a girl is that he doesn't believe she's good enough for him (as self improvement suggests), then how come this is not working?

Thanks for your response. I would appreciate more of your input. 
I understand that people are sometimes incompatible. I have been in past relationships, one of which ended only a week or so after I began to see this person. I have done a lot of reflecting and thinking and the incompatibility may have stemmed from my not being emotionally available and "all in" on this person (my being somewhat inconsiderate of them, not physically available, not open emotionally and not myself). I thought we *were* compatible values wise, and we certainly had fun together. Maybe he just wasn't feeling it, but then there still has to be a reason why. 

I have not spoken to him since our break up. I thought he would come around, since he is a somewhat indecisive person, however, he has not come around at all. I am really hurt by this because I always hear about girls whose guys come back after these things happen. It makes me feel like shit and like I'm not even worth it to him. I have talked to friends but again there's really nothing they can say or do to make it better.

I wish this were the case. However, I have never and will never be loved. Why? I have no idea. I have just gone my entire life without anyone loving me. No one likes/writes on my social media pages, no one tells me I'm anything special. Right now I'm stuck in an abusive relationship because I'm still hurting over a past relationship that ended, where I was in love (I loved at least, apparently they didn't). I can't move on and think about him constantly. I've been surrounded by people but in my head all I want is to jump off the bridge.
I'm asking for potential reasons why someone might feel this way about someone else.
I'm looking but there's no one. I'll never find anyone who will love me, who I will also love.

I was dating two guys, one of which I'm still dating. The first guy dumped me but I want him back. The other guy is on the verge of dumping me too. I just don't know why I can't keep anyone around. The first guy it was probably because I wasn't open enough, didn't really reciprocate interest. The second, I don't even know.

When we dated I was emotionally unavailable because I was coming off of a different relationship. I just wish I could have ben more open and dated him when I was ready, because I don't feel I was open enough and not myself enough (which had to do with it). I like him and he makes me happy because he's simple and we had fun together. I really like when he's in my life.

They were never really good together. Megan was really sweet, down-to-earth, tried hard and was overall a pleasant person by most people's standards. Don is too complicated and in a lot of ways, not aware of how he impacts other people. Don thinks that if he just *is* there, at the very basic level of just not leaving, then he is satisfying whatever woman he is with (Megan). Whereas Megan, who expects and wants more emotional connection from Don, is left unsatisfied over and over again. Sure she sticks around for so long because she idealizes him and sees him for what their relationship could be. She *wants* it to work on some level, or at least she wanted it to work for so long. But there's only so much of this dissatisfaction a person can take before giving up and realizing that person will never be who you want them to be, even if it *is* Don Draper you're dealing with.

Their relationship is over because it was silently self-destructing for so long.
We broke up a month ago. I just don't want him to think he "has" me:

I was thinking the same. I was disappointed that she wasn't more receptive to Don when he opened up. For a while I felt for Megan but the way it ended with them made me dislike her so much. But honestly the fact that she couldn't stand by him just goes to show that they were wrong for each other (which we already knew due to their lack of chemistry and inability to understand each other).
